To truly own and operate their digital commerce infrastructure, creators must switch to sovereign commerce solutions that aren't beholden to centralized payment platforms.

content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) combines GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. In contrast, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) adds Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and more comprehensive automation. Meanwhile, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. With these options, creators can design, document, and deploy their own digital commerce infrastructure without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or other platform gatekeepers.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platform suspension risk is asymmetric in a specific way that most creators only understand after experiencing it. When a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When the platform acts — through automated risk flagging, policy enforcement, or geographic restriction tightening — the creator loses their revenue channel immediately. Funds inside the platform may be held for up to 180 days. The appeals process rarely reverses these decisions. Sovereign infrastructure removes this asymmetry completely. Your Cloudflare Pages store cannot be suspended by a payment processor. Your wallet cannot be frozen by a platform's compliance team.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Self-custody means holding crypto in a wallet where you control the private keys — not in an exchange account, not in a payment processor's custodial system, but in a wallet where only you can authorize transactions. MetaMask, Trust Wallet, and hardware wallets like Ledger are common options for different security levels and use cases. When digital store revenue flows into a self-custody wallet, no company can freeze it, no regulator can direct a platform to hold it, and no compliance algorithm can flag it for review. COREMERCH configures NOWPayments to route all payments directly to the wallet addresses you provide during setup.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce solutions bypass platform restrictions and empower creators to operate globally without worrying about account freezes or payment processing issues.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The ownership structure of a COREMERCH deployment is explicit and verifiable. After any deployment, the customer holds all of the following under their own accounts: the storefront code in their GitHub or Cloudflare account, the customer email list in their Supabase database or Google Sheet, the order and payment history exportable as CSV at any time, the product files in their Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, the NOWPayments account set up under their email address, all wallet addresses and the funds inside them. COREMERCH has zero access to any of these after delivery.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

CREATORS WITH A SIMPLE DIGITAL STORE: Choose the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for a basic, automated commerce infrastructure. CREATORS WITH A COMPLEX DIGITAL STORE: Choose the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for a more comprehensive, automated commerce infrastructure. CREATORS WHO WANT TO BUILD AND DEPLOY A SOVEREIGN DIGITAL COMMERCE STACK FROM SCRATCH: Choose the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for instant access to all 6 blueprints and 7 templates.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The most important question a reader would ask is: How do COREMERCH's sovereign commerce solutions compare to traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal? The answer is that COREMERCH's solutions offer greater financial sovereignty, control over the payment process, and automated tasks like order storage and file delivery, making them the more secure, flexible, and cost-effective choice for digital creators.
With complete control over the payment process, creators can avoid costly fees and account freezes associated with traditional platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching infrastructure ownership and no-KYC payment options are typically at a turning point — ready to build on infrastructure they control after experiencing or observing the asymmetric risk of platform dependency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete sovereign deployment: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all under your accounts, end-to-end tested before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build process for both Stack 01 and Stack 02 for creators who want to self-deploy. COREMERCH has no access after delivery. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Deployment should take no more than 1-2 hours to complete, depending on your level of technical expertise. Here is a step-by-step checklist to get you started: Create a GitHub Pages account and link it to your COREMERCH solution. Configure your Cloudflare Workers backend logic and integrate it with your Supabase order storage. Set up your NOWPayments payment processor and configure it for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Load your digital products and configure automated payment processing and delivery. Test your sovereign digital commerce infrastructure to ensure smooth operation.
